name: users
sql:
CREATE TABLE users (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      username TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL COLLATE NOCASE,
      password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
      is_admin INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
      created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    , "must_change_password" INTEGER DEFAULT 0, "temp_password_hash" TEXT DEFAULT NULL, "is_guest" INTEGER DEFAULT 0, "status" TEXT DEFAULT 'online', "status_text" TEXT DEFAULT '', "display_name" TEXT DEFAULT NULL, "display_name_locked" INTEGER DEFAULT 0, "avatar" TEXT DEFAULT NULL, "avatar_shape" TEXT DEFAULT 'circle', "animate_profile" TEXT DEFAULT 'trigger', "border" TEXT DEFAULT NULL, "border_transform" TEXT DEFAULT NULL, "bio" TEXT DEFAULT '', "birthday" TEXT DEFAULT NULL, "birthday_set_at" TEXT DEFAULT NULL, "birthday_hide_year" INTEGER DEFAULT 1, "birthday_hidden" INTEGER DEFAULT 0, "public_key" TEXT DEFAULT NULL, "signing_key" TEXT DEFAULT NULL, "signing_backup" TEXT DEFAULT NULL, "encrypted_private_key" TEXT DEFAULT NULL, "e2e_key_salt" TEXT DEFAULT NULL, "e2e_secret" TEXT DEFAULT NULL, "e2e_passphrase" INTEGER DEFAULT 0, "oidc_subject" TEXT DEFAULT NULL, "oidc_issuer" TEXT DEFAULT NULL, "password_version" INTEGER DEFAULT 1, "totp_secret" TEXT DEFAULT NULL, "totp_enabled" INTEGER DEFAULT 0, "encrypted_servers" TEXT DEFAULT NULL, official_mode INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

name: sqlite_sequence
sql: CREATE TABLE sqlite_sequence(name,seq)

name: channels
sql:
CREATE TABLE channels (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      name TEXT NOT NULL,
      code TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
      created_by INTEGER REFERENCES users(id),
      created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    , "show_welcome" INTEGER DEFAULT 0, "topic" TEXT DEFAULT '', "is_dm" INTEGER DEFAULT 0, code_visibility TEXT DEFAULT 'public', code_mode TEXT DEFAULT 'static', code_rotation_type TEXT DEFAULT 'time', code_rotation_interval INTEGER DEFAULT 60, code_rotation_counter INTEGER DEFAULT 0, code_last_rotated DATETIME DEFAULT NULL, "default_role_id" INTEGER DEFAULT NULL REFERENCES roles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "parent_channel_id" INTEGER DEFAULT NULL REFERENCES channels(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "position" INTEGER DEFAULT 0, "is_private" INTEGER DEFAULT 0, "expires_at" DATETIME DEFAULT NULL, "is_temp_voice" INTEGER DEFAULT 0, streams_enabled INTEGER DEFAULT 1, music_enabled INTEGER DEFAULT 1, slow_mode_interval INTEGER DEFAULT 0, category TEXT DEFAULT NULL, sort_alphabetical INTEGER DEFAULT 0, cleanup_exempt INTEGER DEFAULT 0, channel_type TEXT DEFAULT 'standard', voice_user_limit INTEGER DEFAULT 0, media_enabled INTEGER DEFAULT 1, notification_type TEXT DEFAULT 'default', voice_enabled INTEGER DEFAULT 1, text_enabled INTEGER DEFAULT 1, soundboard_enabled INTEGER DEFAULT 1, reactions_enabled INTEGER DEFAULT 1, is_forum INTEGER DEFAULT 0, forum_tags TEXT DEFAULT NULL, is_nsfw INTEGER DEFAULT 0, auto_delete_mode TEXT DEFAULT 'delete', auto_delete_interval_hours INTEGER DEFAULT NULL, role_gate TEXT DEFAULT NULL, forum_layout TEXT DEFAULT NULL, "key_epoch" INTEGER DEFAULT 0, "is_group" INTEGER DEFAULT 0, "is_self_dm" INTEGER DEFAULT 0, "forum_votes" INTEGER DEFAULT 0, "forum_blog" INTEGER DEFAULT 0, "forum_blog_pics_only" INTEGER DEFAULT 0, "discord_channel_id" TEXT DEFAULT NULL, "voice_bitrate" INTEGER DEFAULT 0, "afk_sub_code" TEXT DEFAULT NULL, "afk_timeout_minutes" INTEGER DEFAULT 0, "read_only" INTEGER DEFAULT 0, "former_names" TEXT DEFAULT NULL, type_id INTEGER DEFAULT NULL)

name: channel_members
sql:
CREATE TABLE channel_members (
      channel_id INTEGER REFERENCES channels(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      joined_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, "auto_all_channels" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "via_role_gate" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      PRIMARY KEY (channel_id, user_id)
    )

name: messages
sql:
CREATE TABLE messages (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      channel_id INTEGER REFERENCES channels(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      content TEXT NOT NULL,
      reply_to INTEGER REFERENCES messages(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
      created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    , "edited_at" DATETIME DEFAULT NULL, "burn_seconds" INTEGER DEFAULT 0, "burning_started_at" DATETIME DEFAULT NULL, "break_chain" INTEGER DEFAULT 0, "type" TEXT DEFAULT 'user', "original_name" TEXT DEFAULT NULL, "is_webhook" INTEGER DEFAULT 0, "webhook_username" TEXT DEFAULT NULL, "webhook_id" INTEGER DEFAULT NULL, persona_id INTEGER DEFAULT NULL REFERENCES user_personas(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, persona_username TEXT DEFAULT NULL, ferry_target TEXT DEFAULT NULL, persona_avatar TEXT DEFAULT NULL, "blog_comment" INTEGER DEFAULT 0, "nsfw_by" INTEGER DEFAULT NULL, "imported_from" TEXT DEFAULT NULL, "webhook_avatar" TEXT DEFAULT NULL, "discord_message_id" TEXT DEFAULT NULL, "is_archived" INTEGER DEFAULT 0, "poll_data" TEXT DEFAULT NULL, "thread_id" INTEGER DEFAULT NULL REFERENCES messages(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, title TEXT DEFAULT NULL, tags TEXT DEFAULT NULL, closed INTEGER DEFAULT 0, nsfw INTEGER DEFAULT 0, e2e_files TEXT DEFAULT NULL, destruct_at TEXT DEFAULT NULL, "silent" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

name: reactions
sql:
CREATE TABLE reactions (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      message_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES messages(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      emoji TEXT NOT NULL,
      created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      UNIQUE(message_id, user_id, emoji)
    )

name: bans
sql:
CREATE TABLE bans (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      banned_by INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
      reason TEXT DEFAULT '',
      created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      UNIQUE(user_id)
    )

name: ban_appeals
sql:
CREATE TABLE ban_appeals (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      appeal TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      UNIQUE(user_id)
    )

name: mutes
sql:
CREATE TABLE mutes (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      muted_by INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
      reason TEXT DEFAULT '',
      expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
      created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    )

name: ip_bans
sql:
CREATE TABLE ip_bans (
      ip          TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      banned_by   INTEGER REFERENCES users(id),
      reason      TEXT DEFAULT '',
      created_at  DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    )

name: user_ips
sql:
CREATE TABLE user_ips (
      user_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      ip         TEXT    NOT NULL,
      last_seen  DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      PRIMARY KEY (user_id, ip)
    )

name: automod_domains
sql:
CREATE TABLE automod_domains (
      domain             TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      mode               TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'allow',
      include_subdomains INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
      note               TEXT DEFAULT '',
      added_by           INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
      created_at         DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    )

name: automod_infractions
sql:
CREATE TABLE automod_infractions (
      id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      user_id    INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      rule       TEXT NOT NULL,
      channel_id INTEGER,
      host       TEXT,
      excerpt    TEXT DEFAULT '',
      created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    , "weight" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1)

name: server_settings
sql:
CREATE TABLE server_settings (
      key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      value TEXT NOT NULL
    )

name: user_preferences
sql:
CREATE TABLE user_preferences (
      user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      key TEXT NOT NULL,
      value TEXT NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY (user_id, key)
    )

name: eula_acceptances
sql:
CREATE TABLE eula_acceptances (

name: invite_codes
sql:
CREATE TABLE invite_codes (

name: invite_code_uses
sql:
CREATE TABLE invite_code_uses (

      PRIMARY KEY (invite_code_id, user_id)
    )

name: upload_ownership
sql:
CREATE TABLE upload_ownership (
      rel_path TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      bytes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

name: media_objects
sql:
CREATE TABLE media_objects (
      rel_path TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      bytes INTEGER NOT NULL,
      content_type TEXT,
      state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'live',   -- 'live' | 'deleted'

name: upload_tags
sql:
CREATE TABLE upload_tags (
      id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      name       TEXT NOT NULL,

name: attachment_tags

name: high_scores
sql:

      score INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,

      PRIMARY KEY (user_id, game)
    )

name: user_nicknames
sql:
CREATE TABLE user_nicknames (
      owner_id  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      target_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,

    )

name: whitelist
sql:
CREATE TABLE whitelist (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      username TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL COLLATE NOCASE,

name: pinned_messages
sql:
CREATE TABLE pinned_messages (

name: custom_sounds

name: sound_preferences

sound_volumes

name: stickers

name: read_positions
sql:

name: thread_reads

name: user_personas

      avatar TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
      bio TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
      created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      UNIQUE(user_id, name COLLATE NOCASE)
    )

name: roles
sql:
CREATE TABLE roles (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      name TEXT NOT NULL,
      level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      scope TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'server',
      color TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
      auto_assign INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    , "link_channel_access" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "icon" TEXT DEFAULT NULL, "max_upload_mb" INTEGER DEFAULT NULL, "transparent" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "mentionable" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "show_on_profile" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "color2" TEXT DEFAULT NULL, "color_shimmer" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

name: user_roles
sql:
CREATE TABLE user_roles (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      role_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES roles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      channel_id INTEGER DEFAULT NULL REFERENCES channels(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      granted_by INTEGER REFERENCES users(id),

name: role_permissions
sql:

name: user_role_perms
sql:
CREATE TABLE user_role_perms (

      user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      role_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES roles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,

    )

name: push_subscriptions
sql:
CREATE TABLE push_subscriptions (

      user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,

      auth TEXT NOT NULL,

    )

name: webhooks
sql:
CREATE TABLE webhooks (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      channel_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES channels(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Bot',
      token TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
      avatar_url TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
      created_by INTEGER REFERENCES users(id),
      created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      is_active INTEGER DEFAULT 1
    , callback_url TEXT DEFAULT NULL, callback_secret TEXT DEFAULT NULL, subscribed_events TEXT DEFAULT '*', last_delivery_status INTEGER DEFAULT NULL, last_delivery_at DATETIME DEFAULT NULL, last_delivery_error TEXT DEFAULT NULL, failure_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0, can_moderate INTEGER DEFAULT 0, can_use_voice INTEGER DEFAULT 0)

name: ferry_links
sql:
CREATE TABLE ferry_links (

      channel_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES channels(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      guild_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      guild_name TEXT,
      discord_channel_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      discord_channel_name TEXT,
      direction TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'both',
      out_mode TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'command',
      webhook_id TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
      webhook_token TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
      is_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
      last_activity_at DATETIME DEFAULT NULL,
      last_error TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
      created_by INTEGER REFERENCES users(id),
      created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, "discord_channel_type" INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,
      UNIQUE(channel_id, discord_channel_id)
    )

name: ferry_message_map

      discord_author_id  TEXT    DEFAULT NULL,

      PRIMARY KEY (haven_message_id, discord_message_id)
    )

name: ferry_reactions
sql:
CREATE TABLE ferry_reactions (

      emoji           TEXT    NOT NULL,
      discord_user_id TEXT    NOT NULL,

      created_at      DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,

name: ferry_forum_threads
sql:

      UNIQUE(discord_thread_id, channel_id)

name: fcm_tokens

name: user_channel_prefs

name: dm_group_keys

name: dm_group_invites

name: dm_group_rewrap_requests

name: user_signing_keys

name: dm_group_epochs

name: poll_votes

name: scheduled_messages

name: mod_cases
sql:
CREATE TABLE mod_cases (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      actor_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
      actor_name TEXT,
      type TEXT NOT NULL,
      reason TEXT,
      severity INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      duration_minutes INTEGER,
      created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      seen_at DATETIME,
      revoked_at DATETIME,
      revoked_by TEXT
    )

name: forum_topic_mutes
sql:
CREATE TABLE forum_topic_mutes (
      user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      topic_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES messages(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      PRIMARY KEY (user_id, topic_id)
    )

name: badges
sql:
CREATE TABLE badges (
      id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      name        TEXT    NOT NULL,
      description TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      icon_type   TEXT    NOT NULL CHECK (icon_type IN ('emoji', 'image', 'builtin')),
      icon        TEXT    NOT NULL,
      icon_key    TEXT    DEFAULT NULL,
      kind        TEXT    NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('account_age', 'messages', 'forum_likes', 'role', 'manual')),
      threshold   INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,
      role_id     INTEGER DEFAULT NULL REFERENCES roles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
      enabled     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
      position    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      created_by  INTEGER DEFAULT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
      created_at  DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    )

name: user_badges
sql:
CREATE TABLE user_badges (
      badge_id   INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES badges(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      user_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      granted_by INTEGER DEFAULT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
      granted_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      PRIMARY KEY (badge_id, user_id)
    )

name: badge_hidden
sql:
CREATE TABLE badge_hidden (
      user_id  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      badge_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES badges(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      PRIMARY KEY (user_id, badge_id)
    )

name: badge_stats
sql:
CREATE TABLE badge_stats (
      user_id     INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      messages    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      forum_likes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
    )

name: user_connections
sql:
CREATE TABLE user_connections (
      user_id       INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      provider      TEXT    NOT NULL,
      external_id   TEXT,
      display_name  TEXT,
      access_token  TEXT,
      refresh_token TEXT,
      expires_at    INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
      created_at    DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      PRIMARY KEY (user_id, provider)
    )

name: listening_tokens
sql:
CREATE TABLE listening_tokens (
      user_id    INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
      token      TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
      created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    )

name: channel_types
sql:
CREATE TABLE channel_types (
      id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      name       TEXT NOT NULL,
      icon       TEXT NOT NULL,
      functions  TEXT NOT NULL,
      position   INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
      created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    )

name: messages_fts
sql:
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE messages_fts USING fts5(
      content,
      content='messages',
      content_rowid='id',
      tokenize='unicode61'
    )

name: messages_fts_data
sql: CREATE TABLE 'messages_fts_data'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, block BLOB)

name: messages_fts_idx
sql: CREATE TABLE 'messages_fts_idx'(segid, term, pgno, PRIMARY KEY(segid, term)) WITHOUT ROWID

name: messages_fts_docsize
sql: CREATE TABLE 'messages_fts_docsize'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sz BLOB)

name: messages_fts_config
sql: CREATE TABLE 'messages_fts_config'(k PRIMARY KEY, v) WITHOUT ROWID

name: privacy_held
sql:
CREATE TABLE privacy_held (
    rel_path TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    last_error TEXT,
